description: TRANSFORM provides Modelica components for thermal-hydraulic energy systems and other coupled physical processes. ORNL publishes a library, training material and unit-test guidance. The provider is Oak Ridge National Laboratory / UT-Battelle. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: TRANSFORM is Apache 2.0 software. The README requires Dymola, whose access terms and costs are separate. Limitations: Training and testing infrastructure establish a reusable library. No tests were run here, and component-specific validity remains the modeller’s responsibility. For simulation it supports transient multiphysics studies of energy-system components. Related resources: Catalogue hits on words such as transformer or transformation do not identify this named ORNL library.
